login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to your clinic.
login.lockedCountdown: Too many failed attempts. You can try again in {{time}}.
login.patientPortal: Are you a patient? Go to the patient portal
login.noAccount: Clinic staff accounts are created by the clinic owner.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.subtitle: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.setupBody: Your account requires two-step verification. Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password…), then enter the code it shows.
mfa.recoveryBody: Each code can be used once if you lose your phone. Store them somewhere safe — they won't be shown again.

selectClinic.title: Choose a clinic
selectClinic.subtitle: You work at more than one clinic. Which one do you want to open?

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email or mobile number. If an account exists, we'll send a 6-digit code.
forgot.sent: If an account exists, a code has been sent.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Enter the code we sent to {{target}} and your new password.
reset.done: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

invite.title: Accept invitation
invite.subtitle: You've been invited to {{clinic}}. Set a password to activate your account.
invite.subtitleNoClinic: Set a password to activate your account.
invite.invalid: This invitation link is invalid or has expired. Ask the clinic to send a new one.

change.title: Change password
change.mustChange: For your security, choose a new password before continuing.
change.done: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

demo.title: Demo accounts
demo.hint: Development only — click to fill. Password: Password123!
